abstract.p: We investigate segmentation on the ExampleSet dataset.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We propose a segmentation method and evaluate it on the ExampleSet dataset using the held-out test split.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Our method achieves a Dice score of 91.4% on the ExampleSet test set.

caption.p: Table 1: Comparison of segmentation results on the ExampleSet test set.

sec.title: Limitations
sec.p: Our evaluation is limited to the ExampleSet test set. Future work will evaluate external datasets.
